# AI Now Institute

AI Now Institute is a nonprofit research organization founded in 2017 and based in New York. According to its website, the institute challenges and reimagines the current trajectory for AI. The organization maps the state of the AI market, interrogates the industry's key sources of power, and provides actionable strategy to reclaim public agency over the future of AI. Recent work from the institute explores algorithmic wages and prices and examines how AI companies determine and report risks in their products.

The institute's Chief AI Scientist is Heidy Khlaaf, who joined from OpenAI in 2021. The organization frames corporate self-reporting on AI risks as constituting a conflict of interest and a subversion of democratic processes. Khlaaf has written on AI safety and security protocols, arguing that AI companies often ignore established safety practices from other industries. Katie Wells, another researcher at AI Now, has co-authored recent work on algorithmic systems reshaping economic life.
